Measure verified automation/intervention/MTTR/failure/cost rates on an explicit eligible-workload denominator; 90–95 percent remains an aspiration, not claimed readiness.
GATE Prove manual governance cannot be hidden as success, retry loops are bounded, human authority is not inferred and all reported repaired outcomes have real verification.
Implement exact site/cohort/generation release-ring identities with site-local authority; no implicit Production ring.
Implement Multisite/fleet inventory and cohort diff with independent provider/grant/binding truth per site.
Implement pilot-ring health thresholds, bounded cohorts, per-site receipts and partial rollback state.
Implement distributed rollout fencing/idempotency so duplicate workers cannot promote or rollback the same site twice.
GATE stale cohort, split brain, cross-site authority bleed, provider mismatch, partial rollback and missing site evidence.
Define automation SLOs over explicit eligible workload: repair success, false repair, MTTR, quarantine, rollback failure, intervention and cost.
Implement per-site/provider/capability retry/error budgets with cooldown and deterministic exclusion reasons.
Implement backpressure, queue isolation and circuit breaking for repeated self-heal failures.
Implement durable kill switch stopping L2-L4 automatic actions while preserving L0-L1 observation and governed manual paths.
GATE flapping drift, metric loss, queue storms, exhausted budgets and kill-switch bypass.
Implement source-channel/hash/signer/revocation/dependency provenance for runtime/provider/policy artifacts.
Bind supply-chain provenance to candidate generations and certification packs without treating provenance as authority.
Implement downgrade, mirror mismatch, dependency substitution and unexpected source detection with capability-local quarantine.
Expose provenance/revocation status in operator/update acceptance views with bounded remediation.
GATE unsigned, revoked, downgraded, foreign or dependency-tampered artifacts; signatures cannot create grants or promotion.
Implement versioned registry/policy/manifest migration DAGs with compatibility declarations and dry-run semantic diffs.
Capture exact pre-migration snapshots and reversible migration receipts with atomic cutover.
Support declared mixed-generation worker windows without dropping unknown fields or reinterpreting stale evidence.
Require governed review for migrations that lower risk, change authority semantics or make prior ineligible capability executable.
GATE partial migration, stale workers, unknown fields, downgrade, restored old registries and interrupted cutover.
Implement deterministic disposable schema/property fuzz cases for boundary, malformed-response, contradictory annotation and hidden-effect conditions.
Implement isolated timeout/cancellation/duplicate/concurrency/provider-fault injection with reproducible seeds.
Implement differential compatibility fuzzing across certified and candidate versions without candidate output entering active responses.
Feed reproducible fuzz findings into policy/canary/quarantine evidence without automatic authority changes.
GATE fuzzing Production/shared objects, paid/irreversible effects, arbitrary code or blind retries.
Implement restore-epoch detection across DB, files, runtime package, Site Profile and registry generations.
Invalidate stale mutable receipts, leases, candidate bindings and execution assumptions while retaining append-only audit evidence.
Rebuild current artifact/provider/host graphs and reconcile exact site-local grants/authority before writes return.
Implement external-effect reconciliation for actions not rewound by local restore and issue post-restore acceptance receipt.
GATE cloned origins, clock rollback, stale grants, partial restore, revoked providers and unrewound effects; never replay authority.
